title: ANSELM Knowledge Cell (Tier 0)
description: Typed frontmatter for a knowledge cell. Tier 0 of the ontological commitment ladder: a controlled vocabulary and cell types only — no hand-authored ontology.

id.description: Cell identifier, unique within the ecosystem. Lowercase kebab-case.

type.description: Closed Tier 0 vocabulary of cell types.

status.description: Lifecycle state. Superseded cells stay in the thread; they are history, not waste.

date.description: ISO date of the last commit to this cell.

tags.description: Open semantic tags (e.g. safety-critical, propulsion). Open by design — only the cell types are closed at Tier 0.
